question: Damodar Mauzo, who received the 57th Jnanpith Award, is primarily a/an _____________ writer.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Konkani**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Damodar Mauzo** is a renowned writer primarily known for his works in the **Konkani** language.
 
• He was honored with the **57th Jnanpith Award**, which is one of the highest literary honors in India.
 
• Mauzo's literary contributions include short stories, novels, and essays, reflecting the culture and ethos of Goa and its people.
 
• His works have been translated into multiple languages, bringing Konkani literature to a broader audience.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Jnanpith Award** is presented annually by the Bharatiya Jnanpith organization to an author for their outstanding contribution to literature in any of the recognized languages of India.
 
• Instituted in 1961, the award includes a cash prize, a citation plaque, and a bronze replica of Saraswati, the Hindu goddess of knowledge and wisdom.
 
• Damodar Mauzo is also known for his active involvement in promoting Konkani language and literature through various literary organizations and forums.
